name: Ellipse & Ellipsoid Aggregate
title_cn: 三维椭球、二维椭圆骨料随机生成，可选择是否带过渡界面
desc: Randomly generate 2D elliptical aggregates and 3D ellipsoidal aggregates in Abaqus. The interface transition zone can be enabled or disabled, making the tool suitable for heterogeneous material and aggregate-based model construction.

name: 2D / 3D Fiber Generator
title_cn: 二维、三维实体纤维、线纤维生成，可自定义维度、纤维种类、纤维形状等
desc: Generate 2D and 3D solid fibers or line fibers. Users can customize dimensions, fiber types, fiber geometry and other generation parameters for composite-material modeling.

name: Voronoi 2D / 3D 5.0
title_cn: 二、三维Voronoi5.0泰森多边形ABAQUS插件，可导出到ANSYS、COMSOL、CAD
desc: Generate 2D and 3D Voronoi / tessellation geometries in Abaqus. The generated geometry can be exported for further use in ANSYS, COMSOL and CAD workflows.
features: Exportable to ANSYS, COMSOL and CAD

name: 2D Polygon Aggregate 2.0
title_cn: ABAQUS二维多边形骨料在任意形状基体内的多级配插件2.0，可导入COMSOL，CAD，ANSYS等几何处理软件
desc: Generate multi-graded 2D polygonal aggregates inside arbitrarily shaped matrices. Aggregate gradation, size range, area fraction, ITZ thickness and polygon side count can be customized. Aggregate and matrix are created as separate parts.
features: Custom aggregate size, area ratio and polygon sides
Supports circular, rectangular, triangular and custom matrices
Aggregate and matrix remain separate parts
Exportable to COMSOL, CAD and ANSYS

name: 3D Random Aggregate 2.0
title_cn: 三维随机骨料插件2.0，可自定义级配、骨料含量、ITZ厚度、骨料尺寸、基体边界形状（立方体、球形、圆柱等任意形状）。附赠配套的骨料级配计算器插件
desc: A 3D random aggregate generator with customizable gradation, aggregate content, ITZ thickness, aggregate size and matrix boundary shape. Supports cube, sphere, cylinder and other custom matrix geometries. Includes a matching aggregate gradation calculator.
features: Custom aggregate size and ITZ thickness
Cube, sphere, cylinder and custom matrix boundaries
Exportable to ANSYS, CAD and COMSOL

name: 3D Graded Sphere Aggregate
title_cn: 三维多级配球骨料生成插件 可在ABAQUS中生成
desc: Generate multiple user-defined gradations of spherical aggregates directly in Abaqus. Particle size ranges and proportions can be entered in tables, ITZ can be enabled or disabled, and the aggregates can be generated inside arbitrary matrix shapes.
features: Supports cube, cylinder, sphere and custom matrices
Exportable to COMSOL, CAD and ANSYS

name: Custom-Matrix 3D Voronoi
title_cn: 三维自定义基体voronoi晶粒生成插件 采用迭代算法对晶粒分布和均匀性进行优化（而非先生成立方体再切割），可导入COMSOL ANSYS
desc: Generate 3D Voronoi grains directly inside user-defined matrix geometry. An iterative algorithm is used to optimize grain distribution and uniformity rather than creating a cube first and trimming it afterward.
features: User control of randomness and uniformity
Optional grain boundaries with custom thickness

name: Random Element Deletion
title_cn: ABAQUS随机单元删除，可指定数量或比率和删除的范围
desc: Randomly delete elements from an Abaqus model according to a specified element count or ratio. The deletion region can also be controlled.
features: Useful for defect and porous-model studies

name: Random / Ratio Property Assignment
title_cn: 自定义Part单元属性随机、按比例分配
desc: Assign element properties within a selected Part either randomly or according to user-defined proportions. Designed for heterogeneous material assignment and stochastic property distributions.

name: Grain Set by Custom Ratio
title_cn: ABAQUS自定义比例建立晶粒Set以赋予材料属性插件
desc: Create grain Sets according to user-defined proportions so that different material properties can be assigned efficiently. The number of proportions is not limited and both 2D and 3D grain models are supported.
features: Accurate proportional grouping for material assignment

name: 3D Voronoi Skeleton
title_cn: 三维voronoi骨架（均布或随机分布），可导入comsol ANSYS CAD等
desc: Generate a 3D Voronoi skeleton with either uniform or random spatial distribution. The resulting geometry can be exported for workflows in COMSOL, ANSYS and CAD.
features: Exportable to COMSOL, ANSYS and CAD

name: 3D Porous Media
title_cn: 三维多孔介质模型，包含实体模型和网格映射
desc: Generate 3D porous-media models with both solid geometry and mesh-mapping functionality for simulation-ready porous structures.

name: Surface Rust Pit / Bulge
title_cn: 任意自建模型表面生成锈坑或锈凸，可选择球坑或多面体不规则坑等多种模式
desc: Generate corrosion pits or protrusions on the surface of user-created geometry. Multiple modes are available, including spherical pits and irregular polyhedral pits.
features: Suitable for corrosion and surface-defect studies

name: Grinding Wheel Random Abrasive
title_cn: ABAQUS砂轮磨削模型建立插件Random_pit
desc: Build grinding-wheel abrasive models in Abaqus by selecting the wheel surface, abrasive shape and abrasive quantity. Abrasive grains can be polyhedral or spherical.
features: Select the wheel surface for abrasive placement
Exportable to CAD, ANSYS and COMSOL

name: 3D Mesh Mapping
title_cn: 对自定义实体模型进行六面体或其他形状的网格映射，用以针对复杂模型的计算
desc: Map hexahedral or other mesh shapes onto custom solid models. Intended for complex geometries where a controlled mapped mesh can improve simulation robustness and convergence.
features: Mesh mapping for custom solid models

name: 2D Quadrilateral Mesh Mapping
title_cn: ABAQUS二维四边形网格映射插件
desc: Generate a regular quadrilateral mesh on existing irregular 2D geometry. Users can customize mesh size and mapping targets. This plugin performs meshing only and does not create the underlying 2D geometry.
features: Intended to improve convergence and computational efficiency

name: Image-to-Mesh
title_cn: ABAQUS图像转网格插件，可自定义图像，可转化二维骨料图像或已生成的模型图像至网格，操作简便直接点击OK使用不需安装其他附加软件
desc: Convert custom PNG images into Abaqus meshes. The plugin can transform 2D aggregate images or previously generated model images into mesh representations without requiring additional software.
features: Works with 2D aggregate and model images

name: Periodic RVE Sphere + ITZ
title_cn: 周期RVE球带过渡界面itz，可导入COMSOL ANSYS CAD等
desc: Generate periodic RVE spherical inclusions with an interfacial transition zone (ITZ). Parameters are customizable and the geometry can be exported to COMSOL, ANSYS and CAD workflows.
features: Exportable to COMSOL, ANSYS and CAD

name: 2D Periodic Random Fiber
title_cn: 二维周期随机纤维，可指定纤维面积比、角度范围等，可导入cad,comsol,ansys等
desc: Generate 2D periodic random fibers with user-defined fiber area fraction and orientation range. Generated geometry can be exported to CAD, COMSOL and ANSYS.
features: Exportable to CAD, COMSOL and ANSYS

name: Ultra-Dense Aggregate Packing
title_cn: 任意骨料超密堆积，可生成体积比大于40%的级配骨料群，支持ITZ，支持堆积分布或均布，可导入ANSYS CAD COMSOL等
desc: Generate ultra-dense graded aggregate systems with total aggregate volume fractions above 40%. Supports arbitrary aggregate shapes, optional ITZ, uniform generation or packed distributions, and user-defined size scaling and content.
features: Arbitrary aggregate shapes including spheres, polyhedra, fibers and blocks
Custom volume fraction and size range for each aggregate type
Exportable to ANSYS, CAD and COMSOL

name: Neper .geo Voronoi Importer
title_cn: Neper的三维.geo文件导入ABAQUS以生成实体voronoi泰森多边形的插件，后可导入ANSYS COMSOL CAD等
desc: Import 3D Voronoi .geo files generated by Neper into Abaqus and create solid Voronoi tessellation geometry. The resulting geometry can then be exported to ANSYS, COMSOL and CAD.
features: Generate solid Voronoi cells in Abaqus
Exportable to ANSYS, COMSOL and CAD

name: 3D Random Sheet Cracks
title_cn: ABAQUS三维随机片状裂缝生成插件
desc: Generate random 3D sheet-like cracks in a user-defined matrix. Crack shape, number and orientation range can be customized, and users can choose whether cracks are allowed to contact the outer matrix surface.
features: Optional contact with the matrix outer surface

name: Field Output Batch Extractor
title_cn: ABAQUS自定义场输出批量提取插件
desc: Batch extract user-selected Abaqus field-output variables and write the results to Excel. The tool can process multiple ODB files and multiple frames in one workflow.

name: Aggregate + Fiber Generator
title_cn: ABAQUS多种骨料（可级配）混合纤维（可级配）插件，可导入COMSOL、ANSYS等软件
desc: Generate pure aggregates, pure fibers, or mixed aggregate-fiber models in one workflow. Multiple aggregate gradations and multiple fiber size ranges are supported, together with ITZ options and fiber orientation control.
features: Spherical or polyhedral aggregates with multiple size ranges
Solid cylindrical fibers or line fibers
Custom fiber orientation range and directional fibers
Custom line-fiber shapes including hooked-end fibers
